actions.convert_csv_to_excel.description: Turns CSV text into an Excel (.xlsx) file.
actions.convert_csv_to_excel.props.csv_t: Paste CSV text or map it from an earlier step.
actions.convert_csv_to_excel.props.delim: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.convert_csv_to_excel.props.detec: Exact numbers become number cells; values like 01234 stay text.
actions.convert_csv_to_excel.props.file_: ".xlsx" is added if you leave out the extension.
actions.convert_csv_to_excel.props.has_h: The first row holds column names and always stays text.
actions.convert_csv_to_json.description: Turns CSV text into a list of rows you can loop over or filter.
actions.convert_csv_to_json.props.csv_te: Paste the CSV, or map text from an earlier step.
actions.convert_csv_to_json.props.delimi: The character that separates columns in your CSV.
actions.convert_csv_to_json.props.has_he: On: rows become objects keyed by column name. Off: lists of values.
actions.convert_excel_to_csv.description: Turns one sheet of an Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) into CSV text.
actions.convert_excel_to_csv.props.delim: The character that separates columns in the CSV output.
The Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) to convert to CSV.
actions.convert_excel_to_csv.props.sheet: Name of the sheet to convert. Leave blank to use the first sheet.
actions.convert_json_to_csv.description: Turns a list of JSON objects into CSV text, one row per object.
actions.convert_json_to_csv.props.delimi: The character that separates columns in the CSV output.
actions.convert_json_to_csv.props.json_a: A list of objects, one per row. Map it from an earlier step.
actions.convert_json_to_csv.props.markdo: Each object becomes a row and each key a column; missing keys stay blank. Nested fields become columns named with dots, like `address.city`.
actions.create_csv_file.description: Turns a list of rows into a .csv file you can attach to an email or upload.
actions.create_csv_file.props.add_excel_: Adds a byte-order mark so Excel shows accented characters correctly.
actions.create_csv_file.props.columns.de: Columns to write, in order. Leave empty to write all columns.
The character that separates columns in the file. Many European Excel versions expect semicolons.
actions.create_csv_file.props.escape_for: Stops text starting with = + - @ from running as a formula.
".csv" is added if you leave out the extension.
actions.create_csv_file.props.include_he: Write the column names as the first row.
actions.create_csv_file.props.json_array: A list of objects, one per row, e.g. [{"name":"Ann"}].
actions.filter_csv_rows.description: Keeps only the rows where a column matches a condition.
actions.filter_csv_rows.props.column.des: The column name to check, exactly as in the header row.
actions.filter_csv_rows.props.csv_text.d: Paste the CSV, or map CSV text from an earlier step. The first row must be the column names.
The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.filter_csv_rows.props.value.desc: The value to compare with. Not used for "Is empty" and "Is not empty".
actions.merge_csv.description: Stacks several CSVs into one, matching columns by name.
actions.merge_csv.props.csv_texts.descri: Two or more CSV texts, one per item. Map each from an earlier step.
actions.merge_csv.props.delimiter.descri: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.read_csv_file.description: Reads a CSV file (for example an email attachment) into rows you can loop over.
actions.read_csv_file.props.delimiter.de: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.read_csv_file.props.file.descrip: The .csv file to read. Map a file from an earlier step, or upload one.
actions.read_csv_file.props.has_header_r: The first row holds column names. Off: column_1, column_2, …
actions.remove_duplicate_csv_rows.descri: Removes repeated rows from CSV text, comparing whole rows or chosen columns.
Paste the CSV, or map CSV text from an earlier step. The first row must be the column names.
The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
Columns that must match, e.g. "email". Empty compares whole rows.
On: " Ann" and "Ann" count as the same.
actions.select_csv_columns.description: Keeps, reorders or removes columns in CSV text.
actions.select_csv_columns.props.columns: Column names as in the header. Keep mode uses this order.
actions.select_csv_columns.props.csv_tex: Paste the CSV, or map CSV text from an earlier step. The first row must be the column names.
actions.select_csv_columns.props.delimit: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.sort_csv_rows.description: Sorts the rows by one column, as text, numbers or dates.
actions.sort_csv_rows.props.column.descr: The column name to sort by, exactly as in the header row.
actions.sort_csv_rows.props.compare_as.d: How to compare values. Unreadable values go last.
actions.sort_csv_rows.props.csv_text.des: Paste the CSV, or map CSV text from an earlier step. The first row must be the column names.
actions.sort_csv_rows.props.delimiter.de: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.split_csv.description: Splits CSV text into smaller CSVs with a set number of rows each.
actions.split_csv.props.csv_text.descrip: Paste the CSV, or map CSV text from an earlier step. The first row must be the column names.
actions.split_csv.props.delimiter.descri: The character that separates columns. Auto-detect picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe from the first rows.
actions.split_csv.props.repeat_header.de: Start every chunk with the column names.
actions.split_csv.props.rows_per_chunk.d: Data rows per chunk (1 to 10,000), not counting the header.
